This brings the curtains down on Huang’s 33-year old tenure as the head of NVIDIA, the company he cofounded in 1993.
paragraph2: According to Reuters, the company’s board said that Huang had stepped down as president, CEO and board member with immediate effect. This follows revelations that he had two extramarital affairs, one of which involved a woman accused of spying for China.
paragraph3: Meanwhile, chief financial officer (CFO) Colette Kress will take over as the interim CEO of the company. She will retain her role as the head of finance.
paragraph4: The board will now reportedly consider both internal and external candidates to appoint a new successor to Huang.

title: Corsair HX1000i Shift Crystal power supply review: 1000W Platinum efficiency with an eye-catching transparent aesthetic
title_bn: কর্সেয়ার এইচএক্স১০০০আই শিফট ক্রিস্টাল পাওয়ার সাপ্লাই পর্যালোচনাঃ 1000W প্ল্যাটিনাম দক্ষতা একটি আকর্ষণীয় স্বচ্ছ নান্দনিকতার সাথে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Corsair puts the internals of a CWT-built, Cybenetics Platinum 1000W platform on display behind three clear panels, adding side-mounted connectors, iCUE LINK integration and per-pin 12V-2x6 protection.
paragraph1: Built by CWT, the HX1000i Shift Crystal is a showpiece that backs its looks with real substance. Efficiency is excellent, regulation and ripple are tight, and the fanless window covers half of its rated output at room temperature. Taiwanese capacitors, a noisy hot run and a 200 mm long chassis are the compromises, while the ten-year warranty and iCUE LINK integration add genuine value. Reasons to buy +Excellent overall efficiency +Cybenetics Platinum certified +Tight voltage regulation +Low ripple +Fanless up to 500W +Striking transparent design +Integrated iCUE LINK hub +Per-pin 12V-2x6 protection +10-year warranty Reasons to avoid -Taiwanese capacitors -Long 200 mm chassis -Loud when hot -Needs side clearance Why you can trust Tom's Hardware Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test. Corsair needs very little introduction to anyone who has built a PC over the past two decades. Founded in California in 1994 as a manufacturer of memory modules, the company has since grown into one of the largest brands in the PC component and peripheral market, with a catalog that covers cases, cooling, keyboards, mice, streaming gear, and of course, power supplies. Corsair entered the PSU market in the second half of the 2000s and built its reputation there by choosing its OEM partners carefully rather than manufacturing in-house. Channel Well Technology (CWT) has been one of the most important of these partners, producing a large portion of the RMx and HXi units over the years.
paragraph2: The HXi series in particular has long been Corsair's high-end, digitally monitored family, positioned just below the flagship AX models.We take a closer look at the HX1000i Shift Crystal to see if it deserves a spot in our best power supplies list. The HX1000i Shift Crystal is a bit of an odd bird, and Corsair is clearly fine with that. First shown at Computex 2026 and launching on November 12th, it combines the side-mounted connector layout of the SHIFT models with the digital HXi platform, and then wraps everything in a chassis with clear polycarbonate panels on three sides, turning the internals of the PSU into a part of the build's aesthetics. Beneath the show, the platform is built by CWT. It holds a Cybenetics Platinum certification at both 115 VAC and 230 VAC, and it is fully compliant with the ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 design guides. It also integrates an iCUE LINK System Hub and Corsair's PinProtect+ per-pin current monitoring for the native 12V-2x6 connector.
paragraph3: The 1000W model that we are reviewing today is rated to deliver its full power output continuously at ambient temperatures up to 50°C and comes with a ten-year warranty.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareStay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox. Contributing Editor Dr. E. Fylladitakis has been passionate about PCs since the 8088 era, beginning his PC gaming journey with classics like Metal Mutant and Battle Chess. Not long after, he built his first PC, a 486, and has been an enthusiast ever since. In the early 2000’s, he delved deeply into overclocking Duron and Pentium 4 processors, liquid cooling, and phase-change cooling technologies. While he has an extensive and broad engineering education, Dr. Fylladitakis specializes in electrical and energy engineering, with numerous articles published in scientific journals, some contributing to novel cooling technologies and power electronics.
paragraph4: He has been a hardware reviewer at AnandTech for nearly a decade. Outside of his professional pursuits, he enjoys immersing himself in a good philosophy book and unwinding through PC games. quorm Are Taiwanese capacitors really still inferior in 2026? Is it still hard to make a reliable capacitor? Seriously asking. Reply EmmFyll quorm said:Are Taiwanese capacitors really still inferior in 2026? Is it still hard to make a reliable capacitor? Seriously asking. Not inherently, no.
paragraph5: Some Taiwanese makers are very good, and plenty of “Japanese” capacitors are actually made in China or Southeast Asia anyway. Making a reliable electrolytic capacitor is still hard though. It comes down to foil purity, electrolyte chemistry, sealing, and keeping it all consistent from batch to batch. The top brands have the longest track record of doing that over many years. Elite is a decent manufacturer and I do not expect these capacitors to fail early. My criticism is about positioning: on a premium unit that literally shows its capacitors off, and when Corsair advertises Japanese capacitors on the cheaper regular HX1000i SHIFT, buyers can reasonably expect better.

title: Google rolls out Android 17 QPR2 for Pixel phones: What's new, eligible devices and how to download
title_bn: গুগল পিক্সেল ফোনের জন্য অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ১৭ কিউপিআর২ চালু করেছে: নতুন কি, যোগ্য ডিভাইস এবং কিভাবে ডাউনলোড করবেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google has begun rolling out Android 17 QPR2 to supported Pixel devices, adding expanded interface customisation, notification and brightness controls, Auracast audio broadcasting, privacy features and foldable multitasking improvements.
paragraph1: Google has started distributing Android 17 QPR2 to its Pixel smartphone lineup, bringing a fresh set of customisation options, improved privacy controls, security enhancements and changes to the user interface. The stable update, which arrived earlier than Google's usual quarterly release schedule, is being rolled out alongside the November Pixel Feature Drop.The latest software release gives Pixel users greater control over their phone's appearance, notification settings and brightness controls. It also introduces new audio broadcasting capabilities and improvements aimed at making multitasking easier on foldable devices.According to a report by 9to5Google, the update began rolling out on November 10 and covers supported Pixel smartphones dating back to the Pixel 6a.Android 17 QPR2: What's new for Pixel users?One of the prominent additions is a redesigned colour customisation experience. Pixel owners can now select their preferred system accent colour using a new colour slider instead of choosing only from Google's preset palettes.The update also introduces four intensity options — Neutral, Soft, Bright and Bold, allowing users to adjust how prominently the selected colour appears across the interface. Compatible wallpaper collections can also switch between light and dark versions depending on the phone's system theme.Another change gives users more control over the status bar. A new settings section allows them to decide whether all notification icons, only priority notifications or no notification icons should appear.
paragraph2: Separate controls are also available for indicators such as battery percentage, mute and vibration.Google has additionally modified the Quick Settings brightness control. Users can now adjust screen brightness even when an application attempts to enforce its own maximum-brightness setting. New audio features, privacy tools and foldable improvements Android 17 QPR2 introduces two new Quick Settings options called Audio streams and Voice broadcast. The latter allows users to transmit audio from their phone's microphone or a wired headset to compatible devices using Auracast technology. Broadcasts can also be protected with a password.The update also brings changes to privacy and security. A new Private Compute Core logging feature lets users examine data accessed by certain on-device intelligence features. An Agents dashboard has also been added to privacy settings.For users installing applications outside official app stores, Google has introduced a revised permission prompt with options to allow an installation just once, grant permission permanently or reject it.Foldable Pixel users also get improved multitasking controls. A handle at the top of app windows makes it easier to switch between full-screen mode, split-screen viewing and floating app windows.
paragraph3: Other additions include improved controls for connected Bluetooth hearing aids, a keyboard vibration intensity slider and an option to set a preferred home time zone.Which Google Pixel devices are eligible for Android 17 QPR2?Google's latest update is available for the following supported devices:- Pixel 6 series: Pixel 6a- Pixel 7 series: Pixel 7, Pixel 7 Pro and Pixel 7a- Pixel 8 series: Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro and Pixel 8a- Pixel 9 series: Pixel 9, Pixel 9 Pro, Pixel 9 Pro XL, Pixel 9 Pro Fold and Pixel 9a- Pixel 10 series: Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro, Pixel 10 Pro XL, Pixel 10 Pro Fold and Pixel 10a- Pixel 11 series: Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL and Pixel 11 Pro Fold- Other devices: Pixel Fold and Pixel Tablet.Notably, the original Pixel 6 and Pixel 6 Pro are absent from the supported-device list.How to download Android 17 QPR2 on Google Pixel phones?Pixel owners can manually check whether the latest software update is available on their devices by following these steps:1. Open the Settings application on your Pixel phone.2. Navigate to System.3. Select System update.4.
paragraph4: Tap Check for update.5. If Android 17 QPR2 is available, follow the on-screen instructions to download and install it.Google is distributing the update in phases, meaning it may take several days for the software to reach all eligible devices. Security improvements and bug fixes Apart from introducing new features, Android 17 QPR2 also carries Google's November security patch. The release addresses several software issues, including instances of the keyboard failing to appear in search fields, unexpected changes in media volume during voice commands and incorrect charging indicators appearing when a phone is not connected to a charger.Google has also included fixes for occasional system stuttering and choppy scrolling animations. Pixel 11 users receive additional fixes addressing problems with photo saving, background battery consumption and device startup times.The update is therefore not limited to cosmetic changes. It combines interface customisation, improved controls, privacy features and performance fixes in Google's latest quarterly software release for Pixel devices.About the AuthorGarvit BhiraniGarvit Bhirani is a journalist based in Gurugram. He is a Deputy Chief Content Producer at LiveMint, where he covers national and international news stories, focusing on accuracy and compelling storytelling for readers.
paragraph5:
With a total of six years of experience in journalism, he has previously worked with Vaco Binary Semantics for Google, taking on the role of news curation lead, and reported from the field on health, education, and agriculture stories for 101reporters and News9. He has also served as a content editor for entertainment and news media organisations.

Garvit holds bachelor’s and master’s degrees in journalism and mass communication from Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University and Gurugram University, respectively. During college days, he joined India’s only non-profit student journalism network, where he anchored daily news updates and produced his own weekly show called ‘Data Fix’.

He was selected for the YES Foundation Media for Social Change Fellowship in Delhi, the Talking Data to the Fourth Pillar residential workshop, and the VOICE Fellowship in Pune.

He holds certificates in COVID-19-verification reporting, data journalism, food & agriculture, tech policy, media literacy and countering misinformation, and tackling election disinformation courses from Thomson Foundation, IndiaSpend, The Dialogue, US Mission in India, and AFP.

bangla_paragraph1: গুগল তার পিক্সেল স্মার্টফোন লাইনে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড 17 কিউপিআর 2 বিতরণ শুরু করেছে, কাস্টমাইজেশন বিকল্পগুলির একটি নতুন সেট, উন্নত গোপনীয়তা নিয়ন্ত্রণ, সুরক্ষা বর্ধন এবং ব্যবহারকারী ইন্টারফেসে পরিবর্তন নিয়ে এসেছে। স্থিতিশীল আপডেট, যা গুগলের স্বাভাবিক ত্রৈমাসিক প্রকাশের সময়সূচির আগে পৌঁছেছে, নভেম্বরের পিক্সল ফিচার ড্রপের পাশাপাশি চালু করা হচ্ছে। সর্বশেষ সফ্টওয়্যার রিলিজটি পিক্সাল ব্যবহারকারীদের তাদের ফোনের উপস্থিতি, বিজ্ঞপ্তি সেটিংস এবং উজ্জ্বলতা নিয়ন্ত্রণের উপর আরও বেশি নিয়ন্ত্রণ দেয়।

bangla_paragraph3: অন্যান্য সংযোজনগুলির মধ্যে রয়েছে সংযুক্ত ব্লুটুথ হিয়ারিং এইডগুলির জন্য উন্নত নিয়ন্ত্রণ, একটি কীবোর্ড কম্পন তীব্রতা স্লাইডার এবং পছন্দসই হোম সময় অঞ্চল সেট করার বিকল্প। গুগল পিক্সেল ডিভাইসগুলি অ্যান্ড্রয়েড 17 QPR2 এর জন্য যোগ্য? গুগলের সর্বশেষ আপডেটটি নিম্নলিখিত সমর্থিত ডিভাইসের জন্য উপলব্ধঃ- পিক্সল 6 সিরিজঃ পিক্সাল 6a- পিক্সেল 7 সিরিজ: পিক্সিল 7, পিক্সুল 7 প্রো এবং পিক্সলে 7a-পিক্সেল 8 সিরিজः পিক্সେଲ 8, পিক্সেইল 8 প্রো এবং পিক্সেল 8a-পিক্সেল 9 সিরিজਃ পিক্সেলা 9, পিক্সাইল 9 প্রো, পিক্সেলি 9 প্রো এক্সএল, পিক্সেল 9 প্রো ফোল্ড এ

title_bn: টার্টেলমিন্টের দ্বিতীয় প্রান্তিকে ৬৭ শতাংশ হ্রাস, আয় বেড়ে ২৬ কোটি টাকা, ৩৫ শতাংশ বৃদ্ধি
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Insurtech company Turtlemint managed to cut its consolidated net loss for the September quarter (Q2 FY27) by 67% to ₹25.8…
paragraph1: SUMMARYInsurtech Turtlemint cut its consolidated net loss by 67% YoY and 32% QoQ Operating revenue for the quarter surged 35% YoY and 16% QoQ to ₹342.2 Cr While total income for the quarter stood at ₹351.7 Cr, expenses zoomed by 25% to ₹375.2 Cr Insurtech company Turtlemint managed to cut its consolidated net loss for the September quarter (Q2 FY27) by 67% to ₹25.8 Cr from ₹78.5 Cr in the year-ago period. On a sequential basis, the company’s loss declined 32% from ₹37.
paragraph2: 8 Cr. Operating revenue for the quarter surged 35% YoY and 16% QoQ to ₹342.2 Cr. Including other income of ₹9.5 Cr, total income for the quarter surged to ₹351.7 Cr. Meanwhile, total expenses for the quarter also zoomed by 25% to ₹375.
paragraph3: 2 Cr in the quarter under review from ₹299.8 Cr in Q2 FY26. The company also incurred an additional tax expense of ₹2.3 Cr in Q2 FY27. In its investor presentation, Turtlemint said that its EBITDA loss stood at ₹17 Cr in Q2 FY27, which the management called the lowest ever during the quarterly earnings call. In contrast, the company reported an EBITDA loss of ₹40 Cr in Q2 FY26. “Q2 FY27 has been another quarter of consistent delivery.
paragraph4: Platform premium grew 55% You and revenue from operations rose 35%, underlining the depth of the distribution network we have built over the years. Our service EBITDA grew 47% YoY this quarter,which shows that every incremental Rupee of business is becoming more efficient to serve,” said Turtlemint cofounder and CEO Dhirendra Mahyavanshi and cofounder and COO Anand Prabhudesai in a joint statement. On the operational front, Turtlemint noted that it processed platform premiums worth ₹1,214 Cr in the quarter under review, up 55% YoY. For context, platform premiums refers to the total value of insurance premiums on policies sold through Turtlemint’s platform during the period. The company also claims to have added 37,000 new digital partners in the quarter under review, taking its total quarterly active digital partner base to 93,000. Responding to a question about the impact of IRDAI’s new insurance reforms, the management, during the earnings call, estimated that the income of point-of-sales-persons (POSPs) could fall by about ₹1,000 a month compared to its agents. The company believes that this decline could be offset by selling one or two additional policies.
paragraph5: The management, however, declined to share FY28 stress-case numbers, saying it will do so once the final IRDAI rules are out. But it expects service EBITDA to hold flat in absolute terms next year. Founded in 2015 by Prabhudesai and Mahyavanshi, Turtlemint operates an insurance distribution platform, connecting consumers with insurers through a network of financial advisors for car, bike, health, and term life insurance. Operationally, the company claims to be active in 19,186 pincodes with 83 physical branches. Shares of Turtlemint closed 1.5% higher at ₹61.38 apiece on the BSE today.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার ইনস্যুরেন্স টেক টার্টলমিন্ট তার একীভূত নিট ক্ষতি ৬৭% এবং ৩২% হ্রাস করেছে চতুর্থাংশের জন্য অপারেটিং রাজস্ব ৩৫% ও ১৬% হারে বেড়ে ৩৪২.২ কোটি টাকা হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই ত্রৈমাসিকের অপারেটিং রাজস্ব ৩৫% বৃদ্ধি পেয়ে ৩৪২.২ কোটি টাকা হয়েছে। অন্যান্য আয় ৯.৫ কোটি টাকা হলে মোট রাজস্ব বেড়ে ৩৫১.৭ কোটি টাকা হবে।
bangla_paragraph3: ২.২৯.৮ কোটি টাকা থেকে ২.৩ কোটি টাকা। কোম্পানিটি ২.৪২ কোটি টাকার অতিরিক্ত কর ব্যয়ও করেছে। তার বিনিয়োগকারীদের উপস্থাপনায়, টার্টলমিন্ট বলেছে যে তার ইবিআইটিডিএ ক্ষতি ২.৭২ কোটি টাকা ছিল, যা ব্যবস্থাপনা ত্রৈমাসিক আয় কলের সময় সর্বনিম্ন বলে অভিহিত করেছে। বিপরীতে, কোম্পানি ২.৫২ কোটিটাকার ইবিইটিডিএর ক্ষতির খবর দিয়েছে। ২.৬২ অর্থবছরে ২২২ অর্থবর্ষের মধ্যে ৪০ কোটি টকার ইবিটিডিএই ক্ষতি হয়েছে। Q2 অর্থবর্ষে 27 ধারাবাহিক বিতরণের আরেকটি ত্রৈমসিক হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: প্ল্যাটফর্ম প্রিমিয়াম ৫৫% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে এবং অপারেশন থেকে আয় ৩৫% বেড়েছে, যা বছরের পর বছর ধরে আমরা যে বিতরণ নেটওয়ার্ক তৈরি করেছি তার গভীরতাকে তুলে ধরেছে। আমাদের পরিষেবা EBITDA এই প্রান্তিকে ৪৭% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছিল, যা দেখায় যে ব্যবসায়ের প্রতিটি বর্ধিত টাকা পরিবেশন করার জন্য আরও দক্ষ হয়ে উঠছে, "টার্টলমিন্টের সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ও প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা ধীরেন্দ্র মহিয়াভংশী এবং সহ-প্ৰতিষ্ঠাপক এবং সিওও আনন্দ প্রভূদৈ এক যৌথ বিবৃতিতে বলেছেন। অপারেশনের ক্ষেত্রে, টার্টলামিন্ট উল্লেখ করেছে যে এটি ১,২১৪ কোটি টাকার প্ল্যাটଫর্ম প্রিমিয়াম প্রক্রিয়া করেছে।
bangla_paragraph5: তবে পরিচালন বিভাগ ২৮ অর্থবছরের স্ট্রেস কেসের সংখ্যা প্রকাশ করতে অস্বীকার করে বলেছে যে আইআরডিএআই-এর চূড়ান্ত নিয়ম প্রকাশিত হলে এটি করবে। তবে এটি আশা করে যে পরিষেবা EBITDA আগামী বছর পরম পরিপ্রেক্ষিতে স্থির থাকবে। ২০১৫ সালে প্রভূদেসাই এবং মহ্যাবংশী দ্বারা প্রতিষ্ঠিত, টার্টলমিন্ট একটি বীমা বিতরণ প্ল্যাটফর্ম পরিচালনা করে, গাড়ি, বাইক, স্বাস্থ্য এবং মেয়াদী জীবন বীমা জন্য আর্থিক উপদেষ্টাদের নেটওয়ার্কের মাধ্যমে বীমা সংস্থাগুলির সাথে গ্রাহকদের সংযুক্ত করে। অপারেশনালভাবে, সংস্থাটি ৮৩ টি পিএস সহ ১৯,১৮৬ টি পিনকোডে সক্রিয় বলে দাবি করে।

title: OpenAI Brings API Inference Residency To India To Deepen Enterprise AI Adoption
title_bn: এআই-র ব্যবহার বাড়াতে ভারতে এপিআই ইনফারেন্স রেসিডেন্সি চালু করল ওপেনএআই
author: TechPulse
excerpt: ChatGPT maker OpenAI has introduced local inference and data processing for its APIs in India, adding to its efforts to…
paragraph1: SUMMARYChatGPT maker OpenAI has introduced API inference residency in India, allowing eligible businesses to process supported GPT-6 Luna workloads within the country The move addresses data localisation requirements that have been a barrier to AI adoption among regulated businesses and increases competition for Indian AI companies offering locally hosted models Details: The service supports GPT-6 Luna through the Responses and Chat Completions APIs, with both processing and supported customer data storage taking place in India ChatGPT maker OpenAI has introduced local inference and data processing for its APIs in India, adding to its efforts to expand the commercialisation of ChatGPT in its largest market. For context, local data inferencing allows businesses to ensure that both API requests and the computing required to generate responses take place within India for supported workloads. It is initially available for the GPT-6 Luna model and extends OpenAI’s existing data residency options in the country. OpenAI’s India enterprise head Nitin Bawankule pointed out that local inference gives businesses greater control over where their data is processed and could help more organisations move from experimenting with AI to deploying it in their day-to-day operations. “Some Indian businesses have not fully deployed AI for important work because they need the information involved to be processed within the country,” Bawankule said. To use the new offering, customers need to create a new API project, select India as the location for both data storage and processing, and use the corresponding India regional endpoint.
paragraph2: With the launch, India joins Australia and Japan as the latest markets where OpenAI has introduced API inference residency. Global AI Giants Push For Data Localisation In India Data localisation has emerged as an important consideration in enterprise AI adoption. While global AI models offer advanced capabilities, businesses handling sensitive information require a greater understanding of where their data is going. Storage and processing of data before model deployment is something that cannot be compromised from a security perspective for banks, financial institutions and government agencies. For these clients, data residency and infrastructure requirements can limit the use of international frontier AI models in production environments. OpenAI is not the first international AI company looking to address India’s data localisation requirements.
paragraph3: In August, Anthropic announced plans to bring in-country inference for its Claude AI models to India through Amazon Bedrock, AWS’ managed service for building generative AI applications. The move was aimed at addressing data residency and infrastructure requirements that have kept banks, financial institutions and government agencies from deploying international AI models in production. Anthropic has since made similar data residency capabilities available for certain models on AWS Bedrock. For Indian AI startups such as Sarvam AI, locally hosted inference has also been an important differentiator when competing with global AI players. However, the entry of OpenAI and Anthropic into this segment could narrow that advantage as international companies begin offering similar capabilities in the country. For OpenAI, data inferencing is another piece of its India revenue.
paragraph4: The AI giant has established a strong hold on the Indian market, where more than 10 Cr people interact with ChatGPT on a weekly basis. The company is looking to monetise its India holding. OpenAI Expands Its Business Offering On ChatGPT In a bid to deepen its engagement with businesses, OpenAI introduced Businesses in ChatGPT, a beta offering that allows businesses to claim and manage their profiles through a new Business Hub. Companies can update their information, add product feeds and access aggregated insights into how users discover and engage with them on ChatGPT. These insights include business mentions, website clicks and discovery topics across conversations where their websites are cited. OpenAI has also introduced Business Agents, which allow customers to interact with businesses, explore their offerings and ask product-related questions directly within ChatGPT.
paragraph5: However, the feature is initially available only to eligible ecommerce and online service businesses in the US. Businesses in markets where ChatGPT is available, including India, can claim their profiles through Business Hub, subject to eligibility and verification requirements. OpenAI’s broader efforts to expand its presence in India include investments and partnerships to develop domestic AI infrastructure. Earlier this year, the company partnered with Tata Group to develop domestic AI data centre capacity. It has also extended data residency capabilities for certain models through AWS Bedrock.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসারচ্যাটজিপিটি নির্মাতা ওপেনএআই ভারতে এপিআই অনুমান রেসিডেন্সি চালু করেছে, যা যোগ্য ব্যবসায়ীদের দেশের মধ্যে সমর্থিত জিপিটি -6 লুনা ওয়ার্কলোডগুলি প্রক্রিয়া করার অনুমতি দেয়। এই পদক্ষেপটি ডেটা স্থানীয়করণের প্রয়োজনীয়তাগুলি সমাধান করে যা নিয়ন্ত্রিত ব্যবসায়ের মধ্যে এআই গ্রহণের ক্ষেত্রে বাধা হয়ে দাঁড়িয়েছে এবং স্থানীয়ভাবে হোস্ট করা মডেল সরবরাহকারী ভারতীয় এআই সংস্থাগুলির প্রতিযোগিতা বাড়ায়।
bangla_paragraph2: এই লঞ্চের সাথে সাথে, ভারত অস্ট্রেলিয়া এবং জাপানের সাথে যুক্ত হয়েছে যেখানে ওপেনএআই এপিআই অনুমান আবাসিক চালু করেছে। গ্লোবাল এআই জায়ান্টস ভারতে ডেটা স্থানীয়করণের জন্য চাপ দেয়। এন্টারপ্রাইজ এআই গ্রহণে ডেটা লোকেলাইজেশন একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিবেচনার বিষয় হিসাবে আবির্ভূত হয়েছে। যদিও গ্লୋবাল এইআই মডেলগুলি উন্নত ক্ষমতা সরবরাহ করে, সংবেদনশীল তথ্য পরিচালনা করে এমন ব্যবসায়গুলির জন্য তাদের ডেটা কোথায় যাচ্ছে তা আরও ভালভাবে বোঝার প্রয়োজন। মডেল স্থাপনের আগে ডেটা সঞ্চয় এবং প্রক্রিয়াজাতকরণ এমন কিছু যা করা যায় না।
bangla_paragraph3: অ্যানথ্রপিক অ্যামাজন বেডরকের মাধ্যমে তার ক্লাউড এআই মডেলগুলির জন্য দেশীয় অনুমান আনতে পরিকল্পনা ঘোষণা করেছে। এটি একটি প্রজন্মের এআই অ্যাপ্লিকেশন তৈরির জন্য AWS পরিচালিত পরিষেবা। এই পদক্ষেপটি ডেটা আবাসন এবং অবকাঠামোর প্রয়োজনীয়তা মোকাবেলা করার লক্ষ্যে ছিল যা ব্যাংক, আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান এবং সরকারী সংস্থাগুলিকে আন্তর্জাতিক এআই মোডেলগুলি প্রযোজনায় স্থাপন করতে বাধা দিয়েছে। এর পর থেকে অ্যান্থ্রপিক্স AWS বেডরক-এ নির্দিষ্ট মডেলের জন্য অনুরূপ ডেটা বাসস্থান ক্ষমতা উপলব্ধ করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এআই জায়ান্টটি ভারতীয় বাজারে একটি শক্তিশালী দখল প্রতিষ্ঠা করেছে, যেখানে প্রতি সপ্তাহে 10 কোটিরও বেশি লোক চ্যাটজিপিটির সাথে যোগাযোগ করে। সংস্থাটি তার ভারত অধিগ্রহণকে নগদীকরণ করতে চাইছে। ওপেনএআই চ্যাট জিপিটিতে তার ব্যবসায়িক অফার প্রসারিত করেছে ব্যবসায়ের সাথে এর ব্যস্ততা আরও গভীর করার জন্য, ওপেনএইআই চ্যাটে জিপিটি-তে ব্যবসায় চালু করেছে, একটি বিটা অফার যা ব্যবসায়গুলিকে একটি নতুন ব্যবসায় হাবের মাধ্যমে তাদের প্রোফাইল দাবি এবং পরিচালনা করতে দেয়। সংস্থাগুলি তাদের তথ্য আপডেট করতে পারে, পণ্য ফিড যুক্ত করতে পারে এবং অ্যাক্সেস করতে পারে
bangla_paragraph5: তবে, এই বৈশিষ্ট্যটি প্রাথমিকভাবে কেবলমাত্র মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে যোগ্য ইকমার্স এবং অনলাইন পরিষেবা ব্যবসায়ের জন্য উপলব্ধ। ভারত সহ চ্যাটজিপিটি উপলভ্য এমন বাজারে ব্যবসায়ীরা যোগ্যতা এবং যাচাইকরণের প্রয়োজনীয়তার সাপেক্ষে বিজনেস হাবের মাধ্যমে তাদের প্রোফাইল দাবি করতে পারে। ভারতে তার উপস্থিতি প্রসারিত করার জন্য ওপেনএআই এর বৃহত্তর প্রচেষ্টার মধ্যে দেশীয় এআই অবকাঠামো বিকাশের জন্য বিনিয়োগ এবং অংশীদারিত্ব অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে। এই বছরের শুরুর দিকে, সংস্থাটি দেশীয় AI ডেটা সেট বিকাশের लिए টাটা গ্রুপের সাথে অংশীদারি করেছে।

title: Exclusive: Sofina To Lead PlatinumRx’s $32 Mn Funding At $200 Mn Valuation

author: TechPulse
excerpt: Online pharmacy startup PlatinumRx is in talks to raise around $32 Mn (over ₹300 Cr) in a funding round led…
paragraph1: SUMMARYPlatinumRx is in talks to raise $32 Mn in a round led by Sofina Ventures at a $150 Mn - $200 Mn valuation. The proposed fundraise signals investor interest in specialised online pharmacy models focused on affordable medicines and substitutes. Founded in 2023, PlatinumRx previously raised $6 Mn in Series A in 2025, while rival Plazza raised $15 Mn in Series A earlier this year. Online pharmacy startup PlatinumRx is in talks to raise around $32 Mn (over ₹300 Cr) in a funding round led by Belgium-based investment giant Sofina Ventures, as per sources familiar with the discussion. The proposed transaction is expected to value the Bengaluru-based startup somewhere in the range of $150-200 Mn (₹1,400-1,878 Cr).
paragraph2: The proposed investment comes around a year after the startup raised $6 Mn in its Series A round. Stellaris Venture Partners and India Quotient backed the startup in its Series A round. The startup had previously raised around $800K in a seed round in April 2024, also led by India Quotient. Inc42 has reached out to the aforementioned investors to understand whether they will participate in the round. The September 2025 round had helped the startup strengthen its supply chain, expand fulfilment capabilities and build its product and technology teams.
paragraph3: It had also outlined plans to add five fulfilment centres and improve sourcing efficiencies to make affordable substitute medicines more accessible. The discussions are understood to be ongoing, and the final terms of the transaction, including the valuation and investor participation, could change. Questions sent to PlatinumRx and Sofina Ventures didn’t elicit any response at the time of publishing the story. If concluded, the funding round would mark a significant jump in PlatinumRx’s valuation and provide it with the fresh capital required to strengthen its presence in India’s online pharmacy market. Founded in 2023 by Ashutosh Pandey and Piyush Kumar, PlatinumRx operates an online pharmacy platform focused on helping consumers find affordable alternatives to prescribed medicines.
paragraph4: The platform recommends substitute medicines with the same composition, allowing customers to access lower-cost options, particularly for recurring and chronic medication requirements. These medicines are sourced directly from pharmaceutical companies and offer alternatives with the same composition, addressing the price difference between branded medicines and their substitutes. It claims to have served over 10 Lakh customers till date. The proposed funding comes amid continued investor interest in specialised healthcare and pharmacy platforms. While quick commerce platforms are expanding into medicine delivery, online pharmacy startups are also attempting to build differentiated models around affordability, assortment and access.
paragraph5: Broadly, the online pharmacy segment has continued to attract sizable investments. Quick medicine delivery startup Plazza raised $15 Mn in a Series A funding round in July 2026, co-led by Accel, Elevation Capital and Nexus Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors All In Capital and Better Capital. The Bengaluru-based startup operates a pharmacy-first quick commerce model focused on 15-30 minute medicine deliveries. On the other hand, last year, Truemeds had raised $85 Mn in funding to scale generic medicine delivery.

author: TechPulse
excerpt: EV maker Ola Electric reported a 13% year-on-year (YoY) decline in its consolidated net loss to ₹362 Cr in the…
paragraph1: SUMMARYOla Electric reported a 13% YoY decline in net loss to ₹362 Cr in Q2 FY27, even as operating revenue fell 39% to ₹421 Cr The decline in revenue and sequential widening of losses point to continued pressure on the EV maker’s financial performance Total income fell 41% YoY to ₹448 Cr, while total expenses declined 28% to ₹639 Cr EV maker Ola Electric reported a 13% year-on-year (YoY) decline in its consolidated net loss to ₹362 Cr in the September quarter (Q2 FY27), compared with ₹418 Cr in the year-ago period. However, loss widened 8% sequentially from ₹336 Cr.
paragraph2: Operating revenue declined 39% YoY to ₹421 Cr from ₹690 Cr in Q2 FY26. It also fell 7% sequentially from ₹455 Cr in the preceding quarter.
paragraph3: Including other income of ₹27 Cr, Ola Electric’s total income stood at ₹448 Cr, down 41% YoY from ₹756 Cr in Q2 FY26. Sequentially, total income declined 7% from ₹484 Cr.
paragraph4: On the expenses front, the EV maker reported a 28% YoY decline in total expenses to ₹639 Cr from ₹893 Cr. However, expenses rose 3% sequentially from ₹620 Cr in Q1 FY27.

excerpt: Xiaomi will launch the Watch S5 41mm, Smart Band 11, Clip TWS earbuds and four smart home appliances globally on November 17, alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro series. The lineup will also include a new robot vacuum cleaner, expanding the company's wearabl
paragraph1: Xiaomi will launch the Watch S5 41mm, Smart Band 11, Clip TWS earbuds and four smart home appliances globally on November 17, alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro series. The lineup will also include a new robot vacuum cleaner, expanding the company's wearable, audio and smart home portfolio.Xiaomi announces 8 new products alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro Series.Xiaomi is preparing to expand its global product portfolio with a range of new devices alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro series on November 17, 2026. The launch will occur in select markets around the world and feature new wearables, audio devices and smart home appliances. It will be equipped with Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm, Smart Band 11, Xiaomi Clip TWS and three Mijia home appliances, in addition to a robot vacuum cleaner.The announcement was made by Xiaomi through its official X account on November 12. The company also launched design previews of some of its future new products.
paragraph2: The majority of these devices have already been released in China, and on 17 November, they will be launched globally. Here is what to expect from the upcoming launches.Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm and Smart Band 11: Features and designThe Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm will come in a variety of colours. The company's worldwide website says they will receive Black and Light Blue models featuring fluoro-rubber straps, as well as a Ceramic White version with a leather strap.The smartwatch will come with a 1.32-inch AMOLED screen that has a 466 x 466-pixel resolution, a 352ppi pixel density and up to 3,000 nits of peak brightness. It will come with a 590mAh battery and health and activity sensors such as a blood oxygen sensor, heart rate monitor, ambient light sensor, e-compass, barometer, gyroscope and accelerometer.In the meantime, the design teaser by Xiaomi reveals that the Smart Band 11 will be pill-shaped, with a silicone band as well.
paragraph3: Xiaomi Clip TWS earbuds to get four colour optionsXiaomi will be further unveiling its Clip TWS open earbuds at the event. The product is available on the company's worldwide site in various shades, including graphite black, frost purple, pearl white and sand gold.The clip-style earbuds will have a frequency response from 20 Hz to 48,000 Hz. They have an open-ear design to accommodate users who wish to hear audio while still being able to hear what is going on around them.Mijia smart home appliances and robot vacuum launchXiaomi has announced four smart home products ahead of the market launch of its new global product line. This includes the Mijia Tri Drum Washer Dryer Pro 12 kg, Mijia Refrigerator Pro Multi Door 546 L, Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Max and Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max.The additions will help expand Xiaomi's connected home ecosystem and introduce laundry, refrigeration, floor cleaning and vacuuming solutions into greater foreign markets.Xiaomi 18 Pro series to debut alongside new devicesThe Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max will headline the November 17 launch event.
paragraph4: The smartphones will be equipped with a second display on the back and a triple camera system. Xiaomi has also introduced a teaser shot of the red version of the flagship series.The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max features Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, which is said to be manufactured using a 2nm process and clock speeds of up to 5.01 GHz. The smartphones are also expected to reach India, but the company hasn't confirmed the launch date.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact.
paragraph5: Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

bangla_paragraph4: স্মার্টফোনগুলি পিছনে একটি দ্বিতীয় ডিসপ্লে এবং একটি ট্রিপল ক্যামেরা সিস্টেম দিয়ে সজ্জিত হবে। শাওমি ফ্ল্যাগশিপ সিরিজের লাল সংস্করণের একটি টিজার শটও চালু করেছে। শোয়ামি 18 প্রো ম্যাক্সে কোয়ালকমের স্ন্যাপড্রাগন 8 এলিট এক্সট্রিম জেনার 6 চিপসেট রয়েছে, যা 2 এনএম প্রক্রিয়া এবং 5.01 গিগাহার্টজ পর্যন্ত ঘড়ি গতি ব্যবহার করে তৈরি করা হবে বলে জানা গেছে। স্মার্ট ফোনগুলি ভারতেও পৌঁছবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে, তবে সংস্থাটি লঞ্চের তারিখটি নিশ্চিত করেনি। লেখক সম্পর্কেপ্রজ্ঞা সিংহ রায়প্রজ্ঞা একটি প্রযুক্তি
bangla_paragraph5: প্রজ্ঞার বর্তমান নিউজরুমে যোগদানের আগে, তিনি নিউজ৯লাইভ-এ কাজ করেছিলেন, যেখানে তিনি প্রযুক্তি বীটকে ব্যাপকভাবে কভার করেছিলেন, স্মার্টফোন, ভোক্তা প্রযুক্তি, এআই, মহাকাশ এবং বিজ্ঞান সম্পর্কে রিপোর্ট করেছিলেন, পাশাপাশি ভিডিও এবং ভিজ্যুয়াল সামগ্রীতে অবদান রেখেছিলেন। তার অভিজ্ঞতার মধ্যে রয়েছে ব্রেকিং নিউজ, ব্যাখ্যাকারী, এসইও-চালিত গল্প, পণ্য কভারেজ, সাক্ষাত্কার, আনবক্সিং ভিডিও এবং লাইভ ইভেন্ট রিপোর্টিং। তিনি প্রধান প্রযুক্তি এবং এআই ইভেন্টেও কভার করেছেন, নিউজ রুম এবং মাঠের রিপোর্টের উভয় ক্ষেত্রেই তার অভিজ্ঞতা দিয়েছেন।

title: Android Auto’s next Gemini upgrade is leaving non-Pixel phones behind
title_bn: অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অটো পরবর্তী জেমিনি আপগ্রেড পিএক্সেল নয় এমন ফোনগুলিকে পিছনে ফেলে দিচ্ছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Samsung and Motorola flagships aren't invited to this Gemini upgrade.
paragraph1: Sanuj Bhatia / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google is bringing Gemini Intelligence’s proactive suggestions to Android Auto, starting with eligible Pixel phones. The feature can connect information across apps and suggest useful actions without requiring users to ask first. Gemini Intelligence also supports select Samsung devices, but Google hasn’t announced Android Auto support for them. Google’s Gemini takeover of Android Auto isn’t slowing down. Just weeks after bringing Personal Intelligence to the dashboard, the company is preparing another upgrade that promises to make its AI assistant even more helpful behind the wheel.
paragraph2: There’s a catch, though: this next step is reserved for Pixel phones.Buried among the many announcements in the November Pixel Drop, Google confirmed that Gemini Intelligence will soon bring proactive suggestions to Android Auto (via 9to5Google). Instead of waiting for you to ask for help, Gemini will connect information across your apps and suggest useful actions when they’re needed. And if you have a Pixel phone with Gemini Intelligence, it will soon bring proactive suggestions to Android Auto — connecting the dots across your apps to surface helpful, personalized suggestions when you need them. For example, if your friend texts you to ask where you are meeting for a pilates class, Gemini Intelligence on Android Auto can find your confirmation email and instantly suggest sending the address with a single tap.
paragraph3: Say you’re driving to meet someone who asks for the location. Rather than having you dig through emails for the address, Gemini Intelligence could surface the relevant details and offer to share them with a single tap. The idea is to handle the little tasks that pop up during a drive before you even think to ask Gemini for help.That may sound similar to the Personal Intelligence features Google began rolling out to Android Auto in October. However, Personal Intelligence uses information from connected Google apps to answer your questions.
paragraph4: Gemini Intelligence, on the other hand, takes things further by proactively suggesting what you might need before you ask.Google’s announcement specifically mentions Pixel phones, even though Gemini Intelligence is available on a much wider range of devices. Beyond the Pixel 10 and 11 series, Google’s compatibility list includes Samsung’s Galaxy S26 lineup, Z Fold 8 Ultra, Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8, and Galaxy Tab S12 series, alongside Pixel Watches and several Googlebooks. Motorola’s Signature 27 is also on the list, although support is still coming soon.For now, though, those non-Pixel phones aren’t included in Google’s Android Auto announcement.
paragraph5: That leaves Pixel 10 and Pixel 11 owners first in line for the proactive driving experience, with no word on whether other Android brands will follow.Google hasn’t provided a specific rollout date. The feature also requires the Gemini app, additional setup, and eligibility based on country, language, and age.

title: Missing Gboard’s Rambler on your Pixel 10? Here’s how to manually enable it
title_bn: আপনার পিক্সেল ১০ এ Gboard এর Rambler কি অনুপস্থিত? এখানে কিভাবে এটি ম্যানুয়ালি সক্রিয় করবেন তা দেখানো হল
author: TechPulse
excerpt: You might need to force a manual update for Android AI Core.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google expanded Gboard’s Rambler voice typing feature from the Pixel 11 series to the Pixel 10 lineup as part of the November 2026 Pixel Drop. Pixel 10 owners who don’t see the feature after installing the monthly update can enable it immediately by manually updating Android AI Core through Settings > [Google profile] > All services > System services. Once updated, Rambler can be turned on under Gboard’s Settings > Voice typing to polish natural speech, strip filler words, and make conversational voice edits. Reddit user Jalvas7 pointed out that they could get Rambler to show up in Gboard on their Pixel 10 after forcing an update for the Android AI Core app via Google Play Services.To check for the update manually on your Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro, Pixel 10 Pro XL, or Pixel 10 Pro Fold: Ensure you have received and installed the November 2026 Pixel Drop.
paragraph2: Open the Settings app on your phone. Tap your Google profile name at the very top of the menu. Navigate to All services > System services under the “Privacy and security” header. Look for Android AI Core and install any pending updates. Google handles Android AI Core updates automatically through Google Play Services, but it can take a little while to reach all users.
paragraph3: Most users don’t need to do anything here, but if you want the latest features right away, checking for the update manually can speed things up.Once Android AI Core is up to date, you can enable and use Rambler inside Gboard: Open any app with a text field and tap it to bring up Gboard. Tap the Settings gear icon on the keyboard’s toolbar. Select Voice typing and switch your dictation mode to Rambler. Return to your text field, tap the Microphone icon, and speak naturally.
paragraph4: Gboard will display a glowing animation while listening and drop the cleaned-up text into your draft once you tap Done. Unlike standard dictation that transcribes speech word-for-word, Gboard’s Rambler uses on-device AI to polish natural, unscripted speech into structured text. It automatically strips out filler words like “um,” adds proper punctuation, and lets you issue conversational voice edits, such as changing specific words or rewriting a draft to sound more professional, without memorizing rigid commands.GoogleWhile this workaround gets Gboard’s Rambler feature running right away on the Pixel 10 series, the Reddit thread turned into a broader complaint about Android’s fragmented update mechanisms. Users expressed frustration at having to hunt through a fourth separate menu for updates, alongside Android system updates, Google Play system updates, and regular Play Store app updates.
paragraph5: One commenter called the scattered approach a poor user experience for a flagship Pixel, while another joked that Google will soon introduce a fifth centralized update hub.

title: The vivo X500 Pro Max is the most fun I’ve had with video capture on a phone
title_bn: ভিভো এক্স৫০০ প্রো ম্যাক্স আমার জীবনে সবচেয়ে মজার ভিডিও ক্যাপচার।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Vivo's latest flagship is a fun time when it comes to video capture, even though some features are a miss.
paragraph1: Hadlee Simons / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: Apple iPhones have long had a reputation for delivering the best video on smartphones, but Samsung has traditionally been king of video capture on Android. However, vivo has made huge strides since the X200 Ultra. In fact, there’s a strong argument that its phones are the best for video capture.The company has just launched the vivo X500 Pro Max globally, bringing upgrades like a Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, a 7,800mAh battery, and a LOFIC-capable main camera. However, this might also be the most fun I’ve had with a phone when it comes to video capture.Readers' pollHow important is video capture to you on a smartphone?0 votesThe best phone for slow-motion video Easily the biggest video-related addition this time is 4K/240fps slow-motion capture. This is actually the first phone with this capability, dwarfing the 4K/120fps option seen on other devices today.I had loads of fun testing 4K/240fps video capture, as I filmed my cats, birds, and other subjects. I’ve found that 4K/120fps capture delivers a sharp picture, but that 120fps still wasn’t quite smooth enough for me. Meanwhile, older Sony and Samsung phones offered 960fps video capture, but a measly 720p or 1080p video resolution. So it’s great to have the best of both worlds with this new recording mode.It’s worth noting that if you switch to this option, the phone warns you that some background apps will be closed. I’m guessing this measure is needed to keep temperatures down in the event of longer videos. I also imagine that this helps avoid dropped frames while filming.The vivo X500 Pro Max brings 4K/240fps video to smartphones for the first time, and it's a blast to use.
paragraph2: There are a couple of downsides to this feature, though. The biggest issue in my book is that you’re only getting 4K/240fps on the main camera, albeit at 24mm and 50mm (~2x). I’m glad that this works at 2x, although image quality does take a noticeable hit in less than ideal conditions. I would’ve loved to see this mode on the periscope camera, allowing me to get even closer to a subject.There’s also the inescapable fact that this slow-motion option doesn’t look great in low light or under fluorescent lighting, but again, that’s inevitable with even 120fps video. Finally, 4K/240fps video can look overly contrasted at times, ostensibly due to the lack of HDR support. That’s another understandable omission, as 4K/240fps video is very ambitious to begin with.Dual-camera recording done rightHadlee Simons / Android AuthorityDual camera video recording isn’t anything new, as Samsung, Xiaomi, and others have previously offered this feature. But the biggest issue with most of these OEMs is that they force you to use the selfie camera. That means you can’t shoot with an ultrawide lens and a telephoto camera, for example.Recent vivo phones have bucked this trend by letting you use any two cameras for simultaneous video recording. The problem with previous vivo phones in this regard was that the dual-recording option was tucked away in the stage mode.Thankfully, the vivo X500 Pro Max gives you easier access to its Dual View recording mode. Simply switch to the standard video mode, tap the Film Workshop icon, and choose the Dual View option. You’ve also got familiar settings like saving videos as one file or separately, and your choice of picture-in-picture or horizontal split views. Furthermore, you can easily switch between your desired cameras via a viewfinder shortcut.
paragraph3: I’ve wanted more Android OEMs to embrace this dual-recording flexibility for ages now, and it’s a shame that vivo is still one of the only manufacturers offering this.Dual View recording tops out at 4K/30fps, much like Samsung phones. Unfortunately, you’re stuck with the Vivid video style and can’t enable Dolby Vision in this mode. I also noticed visible judder now and again, while there are some minor color inconsistencies. But I do feel that the flexibility of this mode trumps these issues.What else is new on the video front? In addition to 4K/240fps slow-motion and a more logical home for dual video capture, there are a few other new additions to the vivo video formula. Unfortunately, the expanded dynamic range is restricted to the Vivid color mode and Log video. Both modes let you automatically track and focus on a subject in a video, although Samsung does this after the fact while vivo requires you to enter the auto-framing mode via the Film Workshop suite in the viewfinder. Samsung’s mode has the edge on paper as you can actually apply this feature to existing videos, with Samsung Gallery then spitting out a cropped clip featuring your desired subject.As for the actual execution, vivo lets you choose whether you’d like whole body, half-body, or close-up cropping. However, I thought that auto-framed videos often looked extremely over-processed.
paragraph4: I found that the subject’s skin lacked texture altogether, while blown highlights were also a feature. paragraph5: I also appreciate the Film Style mode, which is basically Xpan for video.Much like the X300 Ultra, the new phone also offers custom video styles if the existing color profiles aren’t to your liking. title: Vivo X500 series India launch on November 26; 200MP camera tipped: Expected price and key specifications
title_bn: ভিভো এক্স৫০০ সিরিজ ২৬ নভেম্বর ভারতে লঞ্চ হবে। ২০০ মেগাপিক্সেলের ক্যামেরা প্রকাশিত হয়েছে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Vivo is set to launch the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India on November 26, alongside the new Watch GT2. The flagship smartphones are expected to feature up to 200MP cameras, MediaTek Dimensity 9600 series processors and batteries of up to 8,0
paragraph1: Vivo is set to launch the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India on November 26, alongside the new Watch GT2. The flagship smartphones are expected to feature up to 200MP cameras, MediaTek Dimensity 9600 series processors and batteries of up to 8,000mAh. Prices reportedly start at ₹1,19,999.Vivo will launch the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India.Vivo has confirmed that its next flagship smartphone lineup, the X500 series, will launch in India on November 26, 2026. The company will introduce three models: the Vivo X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max. The smartphones will arrive alongside the Vivo Watch GT2, expanding the company's premium device portfolio in the country.The company made the announcement on Thursday, 12 November, in an official press release and social media teasers. Vivo is expected to focus on camera performance, flagship processors and premium design with the new lineup.
paragraph2: Vivo X500 series: Expected design and specificationsThe Vivo X500 series follows the design language of Vivo's previous X50 series, featuring circular camera modules and the Zeiss brand on Pro versions. The standard X500 uses a different camera design: a round cutout in a rectangular module.The specifications list for the models in the source report indicates that the Vivo X500 Pro and Vivo X500 Pro Max run on a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset. The Dimensity 9600M is likely to be used in the standard model.The X500 Pro has a 6.36-inch 2K LTPO AMOLED display, while the X500 Pro Max has a bigger 6.85-inch display. The default X500 has a 6.59-inch AMOLED display.
paragraph3: The standard X500 features a 6.59-inch AMOLED screen. All three models support a 144 Hz refresh rate.Camera and battery detailsA key feature will certainly be the camera hardware.The X500 Pro Max features a 50 MP Sony LYTIA 910 primary sensor and a 200 MP Samsung ISOCELL HP0 periscope telephoto camera.The X500 Pro has the same main camera sensor as the 64 MP Sony LYTIA 610 telephoto sensor. The Pro models also have a 50 MP ultrawide camera and a 50 MP front camera.Battery capacities reportedly vary across the lineup. The standard X500 features a 7,500 mAh cell, whereas the Pro's battery capacity is 6,510 mAh.
paragraph4: The Chinese variant of the Pro Max comes with an 8,000 mAh battery. The three models all offer 90W wired and 40W wireless charging.The phones are also expected to run Android 17-based OriginOS 7, with Vivo's AI features and productivity tools.Vivo X500 series expected price in IndiaVivo has not confirmed the India prices yet. The leaked pricing information reveals that the entry-level X500 will begin at ₹119,999 for the 12GB RAM and 256GB storage configuration.The X500 Pro is tipped to cost ₹149,999, while the Pro Max could start at ₹159,999. The 512GB Pro Max variant may cost ₹179,999. However, the Pro Max Master Set, which is likely to be a kit with a teleconverter, may cost up to ₹229,999.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing.
paragraph5: She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

author: TechPulse
excerpt: USA-TECH/RESEARCH:US humanoid robot production could hit 400,000 by 2030 as deployment ramps, J.P. Morgan says
paragraph1: USA-TECH/RESEARCH:US humanoid robot production could hit 400,000 by 2030 as deployment ramps, J.P. Morgan saysUS humanoid robot production could hit 400,000 by 2030 as deployment ramps, J.P.
paragraph2: Morgan saysNov 12 (Reuters) - Humanoid robot production in the US will hit 300,000-400,000 units by 2030 and about 1.5 million units by 2035, J.P. Morgan said on Thursday, as the industry shifts from demonstrations to commercial deployment.
paragraph3: Labor shortages, improving economics and rising production capacity are boosting humanoid adoption in manufacturing, logistics and warehousing, as businesses look to automate repetitive tasks.* The Trump administration's finding that imported robotics and industrial machinery pose national security risks could lead to tariffs or other measures to boost domestic production, J.P. Morgan said* Humanoid deployment is constrained by hardware, AI training data and compute, and production capacity, with most US manufacturers outside Tesla targeting 10,000-30,000 units annually* The brokerage estimates humanoid robot costs are nearing parity with labor costs, while multi-shift deployment could generate about $100,000 in annual savings per customer* "Near-term progress remains supply constrained, with a few binding bottlenecks: hands, actuators, the brain, and production capacity," the brokerage said* Component suppliers offer the biggest near-term opportunity, J.
paragraph4: P. Morgan said, adding it expects the market for key parts such as actuators, motors and vision systems to approach $30 billion by 2035* Among US humanoid makers, J.P. author: TechPulse
excerpt: AI-ENTERPRISE/CAPGEMINI (PIX):Most large firms plan higher open-weight AI use to cap bills, study shows
paragraph1: AI-ENTERPRISE/CAPGEMINI (PIX):Most large firms plan higher open-weight AI use to cap bills, study showsMost large firms plan higher open-weight AI use to cap bills, study showsBy Leo MarchandonNov 12 (Reuters) - Nearly 6 in 10 senior executives at large companies plan to increase their use of cheaper open-weight AI models over the next year as AI bills overshoot budgets, a Capgemini study showed on Thursday.This trend echoes SAP, whose finance chief last month said it was replacing some of its costliest AI models with cheaper ones where performance held up.
paragraph2: Anthropic, which launched its IPO roadshow this week, also warned in its prospectus that customers may shift to cheaper options, including open-weight models.Open-weight models, like those from DeepSeek or Mistral, can be downloaded and run anywhere, while closed options, like Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini models, are only accessible from the cloud.
paragraph3: Some 59% of the surveyed executives said AI spending over the past year had been significantly above their expectations or budgets, by 24% on average, while 53% said they were worried about AI costs — last year, 45% of executives had expressed such concerns.Open-weight models handled 72% of traffic on OpenRouter, a popular multi-AI provider, in September, though that represented just 27% of AI spending, Capgemini said.
paragraph4: The IT consulting firm said open-weight tokens were on average 87% cheaper than closed ones. Closed models broadly remain in the mix, with half the respondents saying they would retain closed models where the complexity of the task warranted the additional cost.
paragraph5: Capgemini, which is helping companies embed AI into their existing platforms, surveyed 500 executives at enterprises with annual revenue of more than $1 billion in 10 countries.

title: Samsung’s Phone app in One UI 9.5 could bring a more convenient bottom search bar
title_bn: One UI 9.5 এ স্যামসাং এর ফোন অ্যাপ্লিকেশন আরও সুবিধাজনক নীচের অনুসন্ধান বার আনতে পারে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: It's a small touch, but the new search button location should make life a little easier if you have a big phone.
paragraph1: Hadlee Simons / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Samsung’s Phone app in One UI 9.5 could bring the search button to the bottom of the screen. This should make it much easier to activate search functionality, especially on large phones. It also looks like the actual search menu has received a few subtle changes. The Samsung Phone app has received some welcome features over the years, including Bixby Text Call, call recording, call captions, and more.
paragraph2: But it looks like the company is bringing a small yet welcome search tweak to the app in One UI 9.5.SamMobile obtained the One UI 9.5 version of Samsung’s Phone app, and discovered that the search icon will move from the top of the screen to the bottom. The search icon will specifically sit alongside the Keypad, Recents, and Contacts buttons.
paragraph3: Check out the screens below.This change should make it easier for users to search for contacts and numbers, as they don’t have to stretch their thumbs to reach the search button at the top of the screen. This isn’t really an issue on the Galaxy S26 and similarly small phones, but I can see it being a huge problem on the Galaxy S26 Ultra and other large devices.It also looks like there are a couple of subtle changes after you actually tap the search button. We’ve now got a “Search” header next to the back arrow.
paragraph4: Furthermore, the text in the search bar has been changed from “Search” to “What are you looking for?”.Either way, these seem like sensible changes. But I hope the bottom search button in particular comes to older devices too via an app update. This way, you’d get more convenient search functionality on phones that might not be getting One UI 9.

title: CCPA Fines Ola ₹10 Lakh For Advance Tipping Prompts
title_bn: সিসিপিএ ওলাকে ১০ লক্ষ টাকার জরিমানা করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed a penalty of ₹10 Lakh on ANI Technologies Pvt Ltd, parent of…
paragraph1: SUMMARYThe CCPA has fined Ola ₹10 Lakh for its advance tipping feature, which prompted customers to pay extra by suggesting it could improve their chances of getting a ride. The regulator has also directed the company to discontinue the feature The order puts ride-hailing platforms' pre-ride tipping practices under greater regulatory scrutiny. The CCPA found that Ola's prompts amounted to misleading advertising, unfair trade practices and a prohibited dark pattern Ola initially offered add-ons of ₹10-₹40, later increasing them to ₹140, with custom payments of up to ₹499. The CCPA estimated that customers paid around ₹56 Lakh in add-ons across Delhi, Bengaluru and Mumbai between June 1 and 15, 2026 The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed a penalty of ₹10 Lakh on ANI Technologies Pvt Ltd, parent of ride-hailing platform Ola, for misleading customers into paying extra to improve their chances of getting a ride. In an order dated November 10, the consumer watchdog said Ola’s advance tipping feature is an unfair trade practice and an unfair contract under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The CCPA also directed Ola to stop the practice immediately, pay the penalty within 15 days of receiving the order and submit a compliance report within the same period. The proceedings followed a complaint received against this issue where the app prompted users to pay extra to get bookings faster. “Adding a tip might help increase the chances of getting a ride faster,” a message read. Customers were initially offered preset amounts ranging from ₹10 to ₹40. These later increased to as much as ₹140, while customers could also enter custom amounts of up to ₹499. Ola argued that the payment was voluntary and went directly to drivers. It said the feature encouraged drivers to accept rides that were less attractive to them, particularly those requiring longer distances to reach passengers. The company also said that tipping did not affect its ride allocation system or guarantee faster ride confirmation.
paragraph2: However, the CCPA found that Ola’s own data did not support its claims. Data for June 1-15, 2026, showed that in Delhi, drivers accepted 38% of ride requests with an add-on, compared with 62% of requests without one. In Bengaluru, the acceptance rates were 40% and 68%, respectively, while in Mumbai they stood at 39% and 68%. The authority also noted that Ola changed the feature’s name from ‘tip’ to ‘add-on’ on May 22, 2025, but continued to show messages suggesting that additional payments could help customers get a ride faster. During a hearing in June 2026, Ola demonstrated that its app still displayed messages such as “Improve your chances of quicker ride confirmation!” alongside preset payment amounts. The CCPA said the change in wording did not alter how the feature worked. The authority also examined Ola’s data for Delhi, Bengaluru and Mumbai for June 1-15, 2026. The platform received nearly 39.94 Lakh ride requests across the three cities, of which 3.93 Lakh, or around 9.8%, included an add-on. Drivers accepted 1.
paragraph3: 51 Lakh of these requests. Based on the average add-on amounts reported by Ola, the CCPA estimated that customers paid around ₹56 Lakh over and above the disclosed fares for these accepted rides. The share of customers opting for add-ons also increased between June 2025 and June 2026. In Delhi, it rose from 8.2% to 11.04%, while in Bengaluru it increased from 9.7% to 10.64%. In Mumbai, it went up from 7.9% to 8.37%. The CCPA rejected Ola’s argument that only a small number of customers used the feature, noting that everyone booking a ride was shown the prompts while waiting for confirmation. It also said the feature could particularly affect people booking rides from hospitals, railway stations, bus terminals and airports, where they may be in a hurry and more dependent on getting a ride quickly.
paragraph4: CCPA Flags Confirm Shaming Dark Pattern The CCPA’s action comes after the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) directed ride-hailing aggregators, including Uber, Rapido and Ola, to remove tipping prompts displayed before or during a ride, citing violations of the Motor Vehicle Aggregator Guidelines, 2025. In a directive dated August 11, the ministry flagged prompts such as “Advance Tip”, “Choose an Add-on” and “Improve your chances of quicker ride confirmation”. It also objected to messages suggesting that tipping could increase the chances of a driver accepting a ride. Under Clause 14.15 of the guidelines, passengers can tip drivers only after completing a ride. Aggregators cannot offer tipping options during booking, before a ride starts or while it is in progress. The guidelines also stipulate that the entire tip must go to the driver, without any commission charged by the aggregator, and that tipping options must not be misleading or manipulative and must comply with the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The CCPA rejected Ola’s argument that the additional payment was merely a voluntary tip, observing that tipping ordinarily represents appreciation for services already rendered, whereas Ola solicited payments before drivers accepted bookings. It also highlighted a contradiction in Ola’s arguments. If the add-on did not influence ride acceptance, the representation that it improved booking chances was misleading. If it did, customers who did not pay were placed at a relative disadvantage. The authority classified the interface as confirm shaming, a dark pattern prohibited under the Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023. It noted that the prompts created apprehension among customers that declining to pay could result in delayed confirmation or no ride at all.
paragraph5: The absence of an option to decline or close the prompt was also flagged. The CCPA further rejected Ola’s contention that it did not derive any commercial benefit from the feature because the entire add-on amount went to drivers. It observed that the feature could improve the platform’s attractiveness to drivers and its ride fulfilment rates, thereby serving Ola’s commercial interests. In September 2026, the CCPA had imposed a similar ₹10 Lakh penalty on ride-hailing platform Rapido over its advance tipping feature, citing misleading advertisements, unfair trade practices and dark patterns. While determining Ola’s penalty, the authority considered the scale and duration of the practice, its impact on consumers and the company’s financial position. It noted that Ola operated across more than 200 cities in India and had over 40 Mn users. The CCPA also noted that Ola reported standalone revenue from operations of around ₹1,060 Cr in FY25. It said the ₹10 Lakh penalty was less than 0.01% of the company’s revenue and was warranted to deter similar violations.

title: Apple may make future iPhones shorter and more compact with new 18:9 display design
title_bn: অ্যাপল ভবিষ্যতে আইফোনগুলিকে নতুন ১৮ঃ৯ ডিসপ্লে ডিজাইনের সাথে আরও ছোট এবং কমপ্যাক্ট করতে পারে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple is reportedly considering shorter iPhones with an 18:9 display ratio instead of the current 19.5:9 design to improve one-handed usability. The redesign could also bring a smaller Dynamic Island or an under-display camera.
paragraph1: Apple is reportedly considering shorter iPhones with an 18:9 display ratio instead of the current 19.5:9 design to improve one-handed usability. The redesign could also bring a smaller Dynamic Island or an under-display camera.iPhone 18 Pro Max.(Pragya Singha Roy/Mint)Apple is reportedly working on an even smaller, shorter iPhone design that would make the phones easier to use with one hand. According to a report citing Chinese tipster ‘Instant Digital’, the company is considering changing the display aspect ratio from the current 19.
paragraph2: 5:9 to approximately 18:9. The revamped iPhone might be several years down the road, and it might have a smaller Dynamic Island or an under-display camera, said the tipster.The proposed design is expected to retain a similar width to the iPhone 18 Pro while reducing the phone's height. Apple is reportedly experimenting with changes to the status bar and navigation, both of which aim to make better use of screen space. These plans are in early stages, and the final design may be altered prior to production.Apple may redesign iPhone displays with an 18:9 aspect ratioApple might change the 19.
paragraph3: 5:9 display aspect ratio currently used on the iPhone to an 18:9 or 2:1 aspect ratio in the future, reported Instant Digital. The change would make the device shorter while keeping the same width.This may make it easier to access various areas of the display using the thumbs. Apple is also said to be in talks to combine the top of apps with the status bar. This may help free up display space without being too great a sacrifice of screen real estate.A smaller Dynamic Island or under-display camera could be comingAnother possibility is that the smaller camera's design is related to changes in Apple's front-camera technology.
paragraph4: The tipster suggests that Apple may replace the existing Dynamic Island with a circular punch-hole cutout. The other option is an under-display camera, which would place the camera beneath the display.Ultimately, the final approach could be contingent on how far Apple gets with the under-display camera technology. Instant Digital cautioned that these are preliminary plans and that Apple could revise them before any commercial launch.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life.
paragraph5: She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

title: Public funds ploughing cash into AI will own megatrends shaping economy
title_bn: এআই-তে নগদ অর্থ বিনিয়োগের জন্য সরকারি তহবিল অর্থনীতির রূপান্তরকে প্রভাবিত করবে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: GLOBAL-SWF/AI:Public funds ploughing cash into AI will 'own' megatrends shaping economy
paragraph1: GLOBAL-SWF/AI:Public funds ploughing cash into AI will 'own' megatrends shaping economyPublic funds ploughing cash into AI will own megatrends shaping economy* PwC estimates sovereign wealth fund assets to rise nearly 50% to $22.4 trillion by 2030* Public pension assets forecast to reach $36.3 trillion* State investors take bigger direct role in deals, infrastructure* AI investment is tilted toward USBy Libby GeorgeLONDON, Nov 12 (Reuters) - Sovereign wealth fund assets are set to surge nearly 50% to $22.4 trillion by 2030 as state-backed investors deepen their involvement in artificial intelligence and infrastructure, according to a PwC report released on Thursday.The world's largest sovereign wealth funds (SWFs) and public pension funds have also shifted from passive to "principal investors" that increasingly shape the real economy, the report found."
paragraph2: These investors no longer depend solely on external managers – instead, they are originating transactions themselves and taking controlling positions with operational roles," said Eric Janson, PwC's global private equity and principal investors leader.The report, which analysed the world's 350 largest public investors, forecast that SWF assets will rise to $22.4 trillion by 2030, from about $15.2 trillion, while public pension assets will increase to $36.3 trillion, from about $27.
paragraph3: 6 trillion, and central bank assets will climb to about $20.9 trillion, from about $17.3 trillion.AI AND THE GULFThe growing pool of capital is concentrated in a small group of institutions: the report found that the top 10 hold around 41% of combined SWF and pension assets, while the top 50 hold 77%."As we're seeing in other areas of the economy, the pool is growing more concentrated — to the point at which a few dozen large institutions are positioned to set the tone," the report said.
paragraph4: "They won't merely participate in the megatrends reshaping the global economy. Increasingly, they'll enable, accelerate, and own them."Funds are now more likely to own and operate assets directly and to create entirely new infrastructure projects, the report found.In 2025, the bulk of the roughly $66 billion state investors channelled to AI and digitisation went to the US, while flows to China slipped to around $4 billion.Gulf state funds in particular were "tilting hard" toward the US, the report found, pointing to investment pledges from Qatar's QIA and Abu Dhabi's MGX and ADIA.
paragraph5: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, however, was a notable exception, cutting foreign allocations to roughly 20%, from a peak near 30%, as part of a nascent shift to a domestic focus and "portfolio-wide spending discipline."

title: AI investment faces reality check as returns remain unproven, next 18 months critical: Goldman Sachs
title_bn: এআই বিনিয়োগের ক্ষেত্রে বাস্তবতা পরীক্ষা করা হচ্ছে কারণ রিটার্ন প্রমাণিত হয়নি, আগামী ১৮ মাস অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণঃ গোল্ডম্যান স্যাক্স
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The massive investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure is facing a reality check as concerns grow over whether technology companies will be able to generate sufficient returns from their spending, with the next 18 months emerging as a cruci
paragraph1: New Delhi [India], November 12 (ANI): The massive investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure is facing a reality check as concerns grow over whether technology companies will be able to generate sufficient returns from their spending, with the next 18 months emerging as a crucial period for the sector.According to a Goldman Sachs report, the AI investment cycle continues to expand, with technology companies committing large amounts of capital to data centres, computing infrastructure and advanced chips.However, questions are increasing over the ability of businesses to convert this spending into sustainable revenue and profits.Chamath Palihapitiya, Founder and CEO of Social Capital, said the sustainability of the investment cycle will ultimately depend on whether companies using AI can generate meaningful returns from it.Highlighting the gap between productivity gains and actual business performance, he said the “number of companies that can attribute earnings/profitability gains to AI is essentially zero today”.
paragraph2: He said, “The next 18 months are critical. We will not have the final answer by then, but we will have set the table for a clearing process that distinguishes sustainable AI business models and infrastructure commitments from unsustainable ones”.The report also raises concerns about the business models of specialised cloud infrastructure providers, or neoclouds, which are making large commitments to GPUs, power and data centre capacity.Their business models depend on keeping computing infrastructure sufficiently utilised to generate revenue and meet long-term financial obligations. However, demand from end customers remains a key uncertainty.
paragraph3: The financing side of the AI expansion is also becoming more selective.Miriam Wheeler, Goldman Sachs' Global Head of Leveraged Finance, said investors are increasingly focusing on the quality of projects, developers, leases and tenants.She described the emerging trend in the market as “Up in credit quality”.She said, “Structural complexity will likely come out of the market as investors move up in credit quality without needing to stretch. In the short term, leases with non-IG tenants may remain more challenging.
paragraph4: Developers with an unproven track record, limited equity, or inferior leases will likely struggle to access capital”.The report noted that around 30 AI-related deals came to the high-yield debt market over the past 12 months, but new deal activity contracted sharply after the end of September, with no new deals coming to the market over the last month.At the same time, the report presents a more positive outlook for large technology companies, which have stronger balance sheets and established businesses to support their AI investments.Eric Sheridan, Goldman Sachs' lead US Internet and Interactive Entertainment analyst, identified three major factors that could slow the investment cycle: disappointing demand, lack of access to capital and insufficient power.He cautioned that “If any one of those is missing, current trough of disillusionment could become permanent contraction.
paragraph5: ”The report highlighted that six major US hyperscalers -- Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Oracle and SpaceX -- could achieve returns on invested capital of 15 per cent or more, according to Goldman Sachs' estimates.Overall, the report does not point to an immediate collapse of the AI investment cycle but highlights the possibility of a correction and consolidation if returns fail to match the scale of spending.The coming 18 months could therefore prove critical in identifying which companies have sustainable business models and which may struggle to meet their financial commitments.
